title: SCE 1.3 — Detect Malicious CodeBuild Project Creation
description: Security Chaos Engineering experiment that simulates the '1.2 Create Malicious CodeBuild Project' attack step (a CodeBuild project with an overly-permissive IAM role and an exfiltration-oriented build spec) and verifies that an EventBridge detective control captures the CreateProject API call in CloudWatch Logs within the expected delivery window.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: EventBridge rule exists and CloudWatch Logs group is ready to receive CodeBuild CreateProject events

method.name: Deploy detective control stack — EventBridge rule, CloudWatch Logs group, malicious IAM role, S3 artefact bucket
Create malicious CodeBuild project with overly-permissive role and exfiltration environment variable

rollbacks.name: Delete CloudFormation stack and all provisioned resources
